harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured firewalld on node1 (AlmaLinux 9) as a persistent host firewall permitting only SSH and TCP/8080 inbound, rejecting everything else via zone target REJECT. Verified via firewall-cmd (runtime + --permanent), nftables ruleset inspection, and live port tests (8080 reachable with 200, unrelated ports not exposed via eth0 zone — same-host self-curl artifact via loopback noted and explained). Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured pre-restart boot_id and service health, issued `systemctl reboot`, confirmed connection drop/timeout, polled until reachable again, verified boot_id changed, and confirmed firewalld/nftables/sshd all recovered with the identical persisted configuration.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 OS and existing firewalld/nftables state
Added --permanent ssh and 8080/tcp to firewalld public zone
Set public zone target to REJECT for persistent default-deny
Removed pre-existing unrelated allowances (cockpit, dhcpv6-client) to satisfy 'reject unrelated inbound'
Reloaded firewalld and verified runtime + permanent config match
Inspected generated nftables ruleset to confirm allow-list (22,8080) then reject with icmpx admin-prohibited
Ran live listener tests on 8080 (success) and 9999 (self-curl loopback artifact, explained as not proof of misconfig given single-node topology)
Captured pre-restart boot_id and firewalld/sshd health baseline
Issued systemctl reboot on node1, confirmed disconnect, polled until node1 exec available again
Verified changed boot_id, and re-verified firewalld state, persisted zone config, nftables rules, and sshd health post-restart

evidence.requirement: Persistent firewall permits SSH and TCP 8080
evidence.summary: firewall-cmd --permanent and --list-all show ssh service and 8080/tcp allowed; nftables filter_IN_public_allow chain accepts tcp dport 22 and 8080; config persisted to /etc/firewalld/zones/public.xml

Zone target set to REJECT (%%REJECT%%); nftables filter_IN_public chain falls through to 'reject with icmpx admin-prohibited' for anything not matching the allow chain; removed unrelated pre-existing cockpit/dhcpv6-client allowances

evidence.requirement: Live functional proof of allowed port
evidence.summary: curl to $NODE_IP:8080 returned HTTP 200 from a temporary test listener, confirming the port is reachable through the eth0 zone rules
Captured boot_id 4a743885-c59f-43ee-afde-ef96f7bea723 and confirmed firewalld active/enabled/running before restart
systemctl reboot issued in background so ack returned before disconnect; next exec call timed out, confirming the node went down
boot_id changed to 2a24f144-8126-45be-bf81-242ad42f193b, differing from the pre-restart value, proving an actual reboot occurred

evidence.requirement: node1 post-restart recovery of firewall and services
evidence.summary: Post-restart: firewalld active/enabled, persisted zone config identical (ssh+8080/REJECT), nftables allow chain regenerated correctly, sshd active and listening on 22
